findings.text: the promised 900-second total bound is only per origin: fetch_catalog creates deadline = monotonic() + 900 on every invocation, while endpoint-document mode invokes it sequentially for each engine origin at lines 484-501 and each routing origin at lines 503-514. Two absent origins can therefore hold a launch for about 1,800 seconds, and N origins for N times the advertised bound; the new tests exercise only SiteConfig(global_origin=origin), so they cannot see this. The exact live router path has one origin and is repaired, but the supported endpoint-document path needs one catalog-discovery deadline shared by every fetch, with a multi-origin test proving the whole launch stays inside the bound.

the two inherited test-scaling variables can remove the production bound because retry_seconds accepts every float without a finite or range check. CLIVE_CATALOG_RETRY_BOUND=inf or any value above 900 extends the advertised ceiling, NaN makes all deadline comparisons false and can retry indefinitely, and a non-positive or non-finite start value can busy-loop or fail inside sleep. Keep the test scaling, but require finite positive values, cap the bound at 900 and the start at 30, and test the refused values.

all three new tests drive only HTTP responses through the legacy single-origin route: 503 recovery, 503 exhaustion and immediate 404. None reaches the classification added in 4ceb3fb6 for URLError(ConnectionRefusedError), URLError(ConnectionResetError), or URLError(TimeoutError), and none reaches endpoint-document discovery. Consequently reverting wrapped timeouts to retryable, dropping refused/reset retries, or multiplying the deadline across origins leaves the declared 26-test gate green. Add socketless or controlled-stub cases for refused, reset and timeout plus a two-origin total-budget case.

commit 3f0f0118 increments plan-version from 122 to 123 even though the dispatch contract explicitly said not to edit plan-version or plan-modified. The source manifest then says the plan paragraph has metadata lines unchanged, which is false for the reviewed ae3780f6..fe33bfbc range. The semantic landing paragraph itself is accurate after fe33bfbc, but the forbidden metadata byte should be removed or explicitly reconciled so the record and merge surface agree.

follow_ons: Share one finite catalog-discovery deadline across all origins and constrain test-scaling values to safe positive maxima.
Add direct generated-launcher coverage for refused, reset and timeout errors plus a multi-origin total-budget case.
Reconcile the forbidden plan-version edit and correct the manifest's metadata-unchanged claim before promotion.

raw_text:
Independent review of run r-20260926T205138354076-s17-clive-catalog-retry at head fe33bfbc504e2aa6bf905068a7d75bc157812655 against the true pre-change base ae3780f64168e6e3808d2ee2344d734bdd176e3d. The review intentionally includes 0729fc32, 3f0f0118, 4ceb3fb6 and fe33bfbc; the manifest's orientation base was reset after the first implementation commit and is not the review boundary.

The live defect is reproduced exactly in the source receipt: against a 503 catalog the base launcher made one /v1/models request, exited 2 and printed `clive: global catalog is unreachable: HTTP Error 503: Service Unavailable`. At the reviewed head, the legacy global-origin path retries 502/503 and direct or URL-wrapped refused/reset connections with 2-to-30-second exponential delay. A 404 is demonstrated by the new test to make exactly one request with no retry line. A direct or URL-wrapped timeout is unlabelled by transient_failure and therefore raises after its one five-second request rather than entering retry. The source run's final receipt records 26/26 focused tests and whole-tree Ruff exit 0 at fe33bfbc; its verbatim negative control fails the one selected 503 recovery test and is restored.

The nominal live path is correct, but the total bound is not global in the endpoint-document path: every distinct engine and routing origin gets a new 900-second deadline, so the overall launch can wait N times the advertised bound. The inherited test-scaling variables also accept infinity, NaN, values above 900 and non-positive values. Tests cover only HTTP status behavior through SiteConfig(global_origin=origin); they do not guard refused/reset/timeout classification or the multi-origin path. Finally, commit 3f0f0118 changes plan-version despite the explicit no-metadata-edit instruction, while the manifest says metadata was unchanged.

The review's own exact uv invocation could not initialise the shared read-only uv cache. Running the same files directly under the shared project interpreter collected all 26 at fe33bfbc, then the sandbox denied every loopback ThreadingHTTPServer socket before any changed assertion ran. Those infrastructure failures are preserved in review-gate-head.log and review-gate-head-direct.log and are not treated as product failures. The target tree remained clean and git diff --check passed.
